name: Agent Windows
author: Sam Ruby
description: Persistent Herdr panes on any machine as first-class Omarchy windows, with live agent status in the bar.

barWidget.description: Every Herdr pane on every machine, one click from its own window. Blocked and finished agents light up the bar.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Off keeps only the status counters.

schema.label: List shell panes
schema.description: Off lists only panes where Herdr detected a coding agent.

schema.label: Terminal
schema.description: Terminal used to open a pane window. Only foot is supported today.
